What did the Board discuss about risks t:
- **2024-10-30 — High competition from new players - Chemicals Business (Tier-I):** Large business houses entering commodity chemicals could intensify competition and adversely affect margins. Responses included exploring new strategic initiatives and diversification beyond caustic soda, including ECH, H2O2 & Epoxy.
- **2024-10-30 — Constraints over utilisation of additional capacities - Chemicals Business (Tier-I):** Enhanced NaOH (Caustic Soda) capacity may not be utilised if chlorine cannot be dispensed through own integration or key pipeline customers’ off take. Responses included evaluating downstream chlorine uses, setting up virtual pipelines through partnerships, onboarding bulk chlorine customers, and engaging existing customers about changes affecting off take.
- **2024-10-30 — Geographical Business concentration - Chemicals Business (Tier-II):** Chemical operations are largely concentrated in the western region; the response was to explore other regions/states for diversification or expansion. These risks and responses had been reviewed by the Risk Management Committee on October 15, 2024, and the Board took note.
